title: Ruk Jana Nahi
desc: Rinku, a 28-year-old man living with his father, has lost his will to live. However, a wedding in his neighbourhood brings a constant stream of visitors who unknowingly delay his plans and ultimately restore his will to live and succeed.

title: Anu Aur Di
desc: Late at night, an angry girl had a fight with her boyfriend and called her sister. She had a big suitcase when her sister picked her up in the car. During the drive, they argued and brought up old problems. Things got worse, and the older sister pushed the younger one against the car window in anger. Their argument stopped suddenly when police lights flashed in the dark, and officers pulled them over. The air was tense with anticipation. What would come to light during this unexpected encounter with the police?

title: Annie
desc: Annie, who had recently experienced the loss of her unborn child, crosses paths with an enigmatic homeless man one evening. Unbeknownst to her, that meeting was on the brink of altering her life permanently.

title: 13Th Portal
desc: Everyone in the city wants to touch the sky we have to keep running. There is no time to relax, one has to move on or get mowed down. 13th portal talks about a city like that. A city that’s brutal in its ideologies yet accommodates all. The most popular phrase of the people here is, if you come on board we will adjust.

title: Anjaane
desc: Shreya is a girl who suffers from clinical depression. After escaping a rape attempt, Shreya spirals further into depression and vows to end her life one night. Unknown to Shreya, her suicidal behavior is observed by her neighbor Aryan. The young man races against time to stop Shreya from committing suicide one night. During the night, Shreya and Aryan are drawn close to each other, and end up falling in love. Shreya's depression is finally lifted as she and Aryan embark on a new life together.

title: Kuch Rishtey, Kuuch Yaadein
desc: A tender story of overlooked friendships and unspoken bonds, where fleeting connections reveal the quiet beauty of everyday life and the people who unknowingly complete us.

title: Aflatoon
desc: A narrative unfolding the tale of two brothers residing far from their home, eager to dispatch a sweet treat to their unwell father.

title: Ansh
desc: When Nidhi visits an orphanage with hopes of adopting, she is confronted by the unresolved trauma of losing her own child to kidnapping. As she battles grief and depression, she must find a way to heal and embrace life again. A poignant tale of loss, resilience, and the power of hope.

title: Akhiri Parchi
desc: This movie serves as an inspirational tool for kids, helping them grasp the extent of their parents' sacrifices and efforts to ensure their lives are comfortable and fulfilling, despite challenging circumstances. It aims to convey a powerful message, encouraging children to maximize their available resources and strive for their best.

title: Abba Ki Chaddi
desc: in Small town where she lives.. Whose husband used to bother her a lot and was responsible for everything, One day suddenly her husband starts fearing her in the name of his father's stick.she does not like his words,makes

title: Baggage
desc: The film is about Sara’s journey as she goes about understanding her role in the greater scheme of things. Sara - who has lost her twin sister to a mysterious vanishing - is trying to come to grips with her loss.

title: Barat
desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

title: Antahakaran
desc: As a devout Hindu seeks vengeance, his two associates with conflicting ideologies attempt to manipulate him.

title: A Notice
desc: Notice is a Hindi short film about a couple and the distance which gets created due a loss, it is about the unsaid things in a relationships.

title: A Tale Of An Onion Witch Chapter 2
desc: One year after the mysterious events of part 1, a newly married couple comes across a lady who claims to be Mangla. They are warned about the 150-year-old Witch that wanders around at night asking for an Onion. Things go haywire when a small girl knocks for help at midnight.
